title: Household tool loan and return log
summary: A tool-sharing log for neighbors or households so critical repair tools do not disappear during cleanup, boarding, water repair, or food preparation.
content: Core sequence: 1) Number each shared tool with tape or marker before lending begins. 2) Write borrower, purpose, time out, expected return, and condition seen at handover. 3) Reserve the last working safety tool for common use instead of lending it away. 4) Inspect returned tools for cracks, dull edges, missing guards, contamination, or bent parts before relending.
